caption: This drawing depicts the head and part of the neck of a creature that resembles a lizard or reptile, shown in profile view and oriented toward the left. The head is primarily brown with various shadings, giving a textured appearance to its skin. There is a single, round eye visible near the upper middle part of the head. The mouth is slightly open, displaying a red, forked tongue that extends to the left. The teeth, if present, are not prominent. The cut at the neck is shown with some anatomical detail and shaded in darker tones to emphasize the sliced edge and some inner structures. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details. The overall composition is simple, with the head occupying the center of the image against the blank background.
title: Figurehead from the "Diadem"
